prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: git ls-files && cat pyproject.toml && mypy 2>&1 | tail -40
cat -n src/trailhead/geo.py src/trailhead/report.py; grep -rn "heading\|initial_bearing\|compass" tests src --include=*.py | grep -v "^src/trailhead/report.py\|^src/trailhead/geo.py"
grep -n -i -B2 -A2 "loop\|heading" README.md; grep -rn "heading\|summary" src/trailhead/cli.py; cat tests/test_report.py

mypy && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && cat > /tmp/loopcheck.py <<'EOF'
from trailhead.report import format_summary, summarise
from trailhead.track import Track, Point
import inspect; print(inspect.signature(Point))
EOF
python -I -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); exec(open('/tmp/loopcheck.py').read())"; sed -n 1,40p tests/conftest.py
mypy; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; cat tests/conftest.py
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2; ruff check . 2>&1 | tail -2; git stash -q -- src && python -m pytest -q tests/test_report.py 2>&1 | tail -2; git stash pop -q && git status --short
